title: 第十三章 从未来过这里第十四章 生狱
content_zh:
祁自如听到了，也看到了，看到了外甥那慌不择路的身影，心中一声叹，知道基本上不可能逃出那大高个的魔爪，事已至此，自身难保，也顾不上了外甥。
他目光又回到了师春脸上，微微颔首，似由衷而赞道：“以你和他们的修为，居然只一掌便把他们给打残了，好霸道的掌力！难怪申尤昆屡次说你能打，他们两个联手居然未能在你手上扛过一个照面，不愧是东九原大当家，是我自大眼拙，当落得个如此下场，不冤！”
师春还是第一次这样近距离仔细打量他，目光盯上了他手里的两张符篆和一只紧抓的乌布小口袋，闻言又盯在了他脸上，“你是什么人？”
祁自如淡定道：“还重要吗？”
对这回答，师春眉头略挑，以示不满，“看样子，你是新来的。此地也不是随便什么罪名都能进来的，听说申尤昆是因为什么‘百童宴’进来的，你呢，你又是犯了什么事进来的？”
所谓“百童宴”不是什么好事，也是申尤昆当初被他软禁时自己交代的。
可能是好东西吃多了，就想吃点特别的，于是申尤昆那厮品上了“脑豆腐”，后来为了追求鲜嫩，干脆对孩童下起了手，宴请一帮狐朋狗友时，竟搞了百对童男女来设宴，结果被人捅了出来，导致进了这里。
申尤昆对此颇有怨言，自家地盘上的东西，吃点怎么了？自家地盘上的东西不都是自家说的算么，又不是我一人特立独行。
他对被罚没什么怨言，怨那捅出去导致风声扩大的人。
祁自如依然是那句话，“还重要吗？”
见对方如此敷衍应付，师春语调沉了下来，“当我不敢杀你？”
祁自如淡定以对，“你去而复返，不就是为了来杀我的吗？”
此话倒是说的师春有些无言以对，没错，他就是跑来灭口的。
很快，申尤昆“啊啊”哀嚎的声音传了来，人也来了，是被吴斤两揪着头发拖回来的。
明亮月色下的吴斤两一手拖刀，一手拖人，跑的飞快，不把人当人，不多时，人拖到了师春跟前一甩，翻倒在了师春脚下。
申尤昆抬头对上师春垂视的目光立马爬好，对着跪，脑门子抵在了地上，哆嗦着，真正吓到了瑟瑟发抖的地步。
一旁的祁自如有些没眼看了，遗憾闭目，憾不该为了这外甥介入流放之地的事，不值得。
吴斤两上前，一脚踩在了申尤昆的背上，嘿嘿训话，“姓申的，你还真是打不怕呀，有没有告诉过你，再惹我们不会放过你？”
埋头在地的申尤昆立马呜声辩解，“我没惹你们，是你们自己跑来的。”
“呃…”拄刀在地踩着人的吴斤两忍不住挠头，对师春干笑一声，“春天，这次好像确实是咱们主动凑过来的，咦，不对…”他突然抬脚照着申尤昆后背跺了两脚，将人给跺趴下了，“明明是你弄一堆物资勾引在先，还敢说没招惹我们，分明是拿我们的话当放屁，竟敢偷偷摸摸送东西给我们，分明是不把我们放在眼里，还敢狡辩…”

师春抬手掸了掸，示意他打住靠边，吴斤两这才罢手了。
师春也不耽误时间，直接问道：“谁来告诉我，为何要挖地下那副骨头架子？”
呜呜哼哼的申尤昆立刻安静了，悄悄侧头抬眼偷看舅舅。
祁自如也蔑了他一眼，淡淡道：“申尤昆，他们冒险回来，就是来灭口的，我们说不说都得死，明白吗？”
他就是在提醒申尤昆闭嘴。
申尤昆浑身一颤，明白了。
“狗东西！”吴斤两不满了，盯着祁自如恶狠狠道：“春天，我拎一个走，分开了审，不怕不开口。”
师春却盯向了地上的申尤昆，答非所问道：“也就是说，真相你也知道。”
此话一出，祁自如眉头一颤，猛然意识到了什么，结果不出他所料，那位大当家骤然拔了地上的刀，在他眼前划过一道寒光，唰的一声，他的视线便翻飞了起来。
噗通，一颗脑袋掉在了申尤昆面前，他猛然瞪大了眼，甥舅二人以如此方式面对面，是他从未想到过的，紧跟着是溅洒的热血泼在了他的脸上。
“啊！”申尤昆陡然发出了犹如女人般的尖叫，猛然后翻起，坐在地上蹬腿后爬，亲眼看到舅舅的残躯抽搐着倒下。
惊魂未定，带血的刀锋又递到了他眼前，师春对他更了解，也更有信心，威逼道：“说还是不说？”
申尤昆喉结连连耸动，干咽着颤声道：“我说了你也会杀我灭口。”
content_en:
Qi Ziru heard and saw his nephew's panic-stricken figure, and sighed in his heart, knowing that it was basically impossible to escape from the clutches of the tall man. At this point, he couldn't protect himself, and he couldn't care about his nephew.
His eyes returned to Shi Chun's face, he nodded slightly, and praised sincerely: "With your cultivation and theirs, you actually crippled them with just one palm. What a domineering palm power! No wonder Shen Youkun repeatedly said that you can fight, but the two of them jointly failed to survive a confrontation in your hands. You are worthy of being the master of Dongjiuyuan, but I am arrogant and clumsy. I deserve to end up like this. It is not unfair!"
This was the first time that Shi Chun looked at him carefully at such a close range. His eyes focused on the two talismans in his hand and a small Ubu bag that he was holding tightly. Hearing this, he stared at his face again, "Who are you?"
Qi Ziru said calmly: "Is it still important?"
At this answer, Shi Chun raised his eyebrows slightly to show his dissatisfaction, "It seems that you are new here. You can't come here for any crime. I heard that Shen Youkun came here because of the 'Hundred Children's Banquet'. What about you, what did you commit for coming here?"
The so-called "Hundred Children's Banquet" is not a good thing, which is what Shen Youkun himself confessed when he was under house arrest.
Maybe he had eaten too much good food and wanted to eat something special, so Shen Youkun ordered "brain tofu". Later, in order to pursue freshness, he even attacked children. When a group of friends were having a banquet, hundreds of pairs of boys and girls came to the banquet. As a result, they were stabbed out and ended up here.
Shen Youkun complained about this. What happened to the food on his own territory? Isn’t it my own decision to decide on everything on my own territory? I’m not the only one to act independently.
He didn't complain about being punished, he only complained about the person who exposed him and spread the news.
Qi Ziru still said the same thing, "Is it still important?"
Seeing the other party's perfunctory response, Shi Chun's tone darkened, "Do you think I don't dare to kill you?"
Qi Ziru responded calmly, "Aren't you coming back just to kill me?"
These words made Shi Chun speechless. Yes, he came here to silence him.
Soon, Shen Youkun's wailing voice came, and someone came. Wu Jinliang dragged him back by his hair.
Under the bright moonlight, Wu Jinliang dragged the knife with one hand and the person with the other. He ran very fast, not treating the person as a human being. After a while, the person was dragged in front of Shi Chun and he was thrown over, falling at Shi Chun's feet.
Shen Youkun raised his head and looked down at Master Chun. He immediately climbed up and knelt down, with his forehead on the ground, trembling, truly frightened to the point of shivering.
Qi Ziru on the side looked a little blind, closing his eyes regretfully, regretting that he shouldn't be involved in the exile land for his nephew, it wasn't worth it.
Wu Jinliang stepped forward, stepped on Shen Youkun's back, and lectured, "Shen Youkun, you are really not afraid of being beaten. Have you told us that if you mess with us again, we won't let you go?"
Shen Youkun, who had his head buried on the ground, immediately whined in defense, "I didn't mess with you, you came here on your own."
"Uh..." Wu Jinliang, who was trampling people on the ground with a knife, couldn't help scratching his head and laughed dryly at Shi Chun, "Chun, it seems that we took the initiative to come over this time. Hey, that's not right..." He suddenly raised his foot and stamped on Shen Youkun's back. The man stomped to the ground, "You obviously brought a bunch of supplies to seduce us first, and you dared to say that you didn't provoke us. You clearly took our words as fart, and you dared to secretly give us things. You clearly don't take us seriously, and you dare to quibble..."
Shi Chun raised his hand and dusted it, signaling him to stop and move aside. Only then did Wu Jinliang stop.
Shi Chun didn't waste any time and asked directly: "Who can tell me why we need to dig up that skeleton in the ground?"
Shen Youkun, who was whining, immediately became quiet and quietly turned his head to peek at his uncle.
Qi Ziru also looked at him with disdain and said lightly: "Shen Youkun, they took the risk to come back just to silence them. We saidIf you don't tell me, you will die, do you understand? "
He was reminding Shen Yukun to shut up.
Shen Youkun shuddered and understood.
“Bullshit! Wu Jinliang was dissatisfied. He stared at Qi Ziru and said fiercely: "In the spring, I will take one away and separate them for interrogation. I am not afraid not to speak." "
Shi Chun stared at Shen Youkun on the ground and asked an unexpected question: "In other words, you also know the truth. "
As soon as he said these words, Qi Ziru's brows trembled, and he suddenly realized something. As he expected, the head master suddenly pulled out the knife on the ground, and a cold light flashed in front of his eyes. With a swish sound, his eyes flew.
With a pop, a head fell in front of Shen Youkun, and his eyes suddenly widened. He had never imagined that the nephew and uncle would face each other in such a way, and then hot blood splashed on his face.
"Ah! "Shen Youkun suddenly let out a scream like a woman, suddenly rolled up, sat on the ground and kicked his legs back, seeing with his own eyes his uncle's body twitching and falling down.
Still in shock, the bloody blade was handed to him again. Shi Chun knew him better and was more confident, so he threatened: "Say it or not? "
Shen Youkun's Adam's apple twitched repeatedly, and he swallowed dryly and said with a trembling voice: "I told you that you would kill me and silence me. "
